extraction.notes: Three-month 2024 column from the FFO/AFFO reconciliation (page 7). Net loss attributable to common stockholders reconciles: -2,205 + 6,499 + 1,379 - 4 = 5,669; AFFO 5,669 - 537 - 45 + 1,189 + 324 + 30 + 139 = 6,769. Zero-valued lines (shown as '—' for Q3 2024) are recorded as 0. BRT reports no core FFO metric. Diluted shares printed as 18,758,435 and converted to 18,758.435 thousands; 5,669/18,758.435 = $0.30 and 6,769/18,758.435 = $0.36, matching reported per-share figures. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex; the quarterly BRT-share estimated recurring capex of $867,000 (gross $953,000, JV partner share $86,000) is taken from the Value-Add Program and Capital Expenditures table (page 11) and converted to thousands. Recurring capex figure is an estimate and is not a line in the AFFO reconciliation.
